units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 10:11:2">Y. B. Kam. X, end, 7ᶜ</cite> <he>מְשִׁיכַת המחט</he>, v. <cite ref="M00850"><he>מַחַט</he></cite>.
Num. R. s. 18, beg. משיכת דברים רכים the drawing (winning) power of soft words; Tanḥ. Korah 1; a. e.—Esp. m’shikhah, taking possession by drawing towards one’s self the object to be acquired.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kiddushin 1:4">Kidd. I, 4</cite> <he>נקנית במ׳</he> is taken possession of by pulling, contrad. to <cite ref="E00056"><he>הַגְבָּהָה</he></cite> a. <cite ref="M01934"><he>מְסִירָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 9a:7">B. Mets. 9ᵃ</cite>, contrad. to <cite ref="E00670"><he>הַנְהָגָה</he></cite>.
Ib. 47ᵇ, a. e. כדרך שתיקנו מ׳ וכ׳ as the scholars declared m’shikhah to be necessary to bind the seller, so did they make it necessary to bind the buyer; a. fr.
